localized_root_causes.description: The workflow challenges missing-control findings but does not explicitly stop searching for replacement defects after supplied evidence satisfies the target invariant.
A hypothetical type/schema/runtime mismatch can still be promoted to LIKELY without affirmative evidence that the prerequisite condition exists.
NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE_FOUND exists as a ship state, but the review process does not strongly require using it when no evidence-backed material candidate survives challenge.
The final self-check does not explicitly reject technically impossible or language-semantics-invalid failure mechanisms before they become findings.

required_successor_rules: When supplied evidence directly satisfies the reviewed invariant, mark that invariant satisfied unless contradictory supplied evidence exists.
Do not search for or manufacture adjacent defects merely to populate Material findings.

A hypothetical prerequisite that is not supplied or observed cannot support LIKELY; it is at most QUESTION and normally belongs outside Material findings unless resolving it could materially change the ship decision.
If no independently evidence-backed material finding survives challenge, return NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE_FOUND.
Reject candidate findings whose stated language/runtime semantics are technically false.
preservation_constraints: Keep the v2 negative-evidence cap for unobserved external authorization boundaries.
Keep conditional downstream impacts from inflating evidence or severity.
Keep CONFIRMED and BLOCK available when the complete supplied boundary directly establishes a high/critical failure.
